ruler_question.question: Will NVIDIA begin shipping its Rubin Ultra generation, in Kyber NVL144 racks, by December 31, 2027?

rungs.label: Yes
rungs.condition: NVIDIA has begun shipping Rubin Ultra systems by December 31, 2027.

rungs.label: No
rungs.condition: NVIDIA has not begun shipping Rubin Ultra systems by December 31, 2027.

judged_question.question: Will NVIDIA begin shipping its Kyber NVL144 rack architecture by December 31, 2028?
judged_question.looks_at: Whether NVIDIA begins shipping its Kyber NVL144 rack architecture by the end of 2028.

judged_rungs.label: Yes
judged_rungs.condition: NVIDIA has begun shipping the Kyber NVL144 rack architecture by 2028-12-31.

judged_rungs.label: No
judged_rungs.condition: NVIDIA has not begun shipping the Kyber NVL144 rack architecture by 2028-12-31.

reader_b_decisive_items.title: Nvidia's next-gen AI rack system delayed to 2028 on manufacturing snags, SemiAnalysis says
reader_b_decisive_items.passage: Kyber NVL144 rack architecture has been delayed to 2028 as the PCB midplane remains challenging from a manufacturability standpoint

meaning.who: SemiAnalysis (a research firm's report, not NVIDIA)
meaning.what: Kyber NVL144 rack for Vera Rubin Ultra delayed; cause: PCB midplane manufacturability

reader_b_decisive_items.title: Nvidia's Kyber NVL144 reportedly pushed back more than a year, Asian suppliers drop
reader_b_decisive_items.passage: The more powerful version of the upcoming Rubin Ultra chip with four compute dies has also been canceled. Only the smaller two-die version remains, delivering roughly half the real-world compute performance.

meaning.what: four-die Rubin Ultra cancelled; two-die version remains

reader_b_decisive_items.title: Nvidia's Kyber NVL144 reportedly pushed back more than a year, Asian suppliers drop
reader_b_decisive_items.passage: Nvidia plans to make up for the shortfall by selling more Oberon-Rubin racks in the existing form factor.

meaning.what: sell more Oberon-Rubin racks to cover the Kyber gap

reader_b_decisive_items.title: Nvidia's next-gen AI rack system delayed to 2028 on manufacturing snags, SemiAnalysis says

meaning.what: rejects the SemiAnalysis report; says its roadmap (Rubin Ultra / Kyber in 2027) is unchanged

reader_b_decisive_items.title: Nvidia's Kyber rack for Rubin Ultra reportedly delayed to 2028, stopgap solution also axed due to customer pushback — Analyst firm SemiAnalysis says PCB midplane problems led to the delay [Updated]
reader_b_decisive_items.passage: An Nvidia representative responded with a short statement to Tom's Hardware : "Our roadmap is intact."

meaning.condition: unclear whether the original or an already updated roadmap is meant
